notes.title: Dungeon Manager ZV Update! Ver 2.20E
notes.content:
http://ent.zoo.jp/images/DMZV_update_image02.png
Dungeon Manager ZV Update:  Japanese now available!
オリジナルの日本語版がプレイ出来るようになりました！

You can now choose to play in the original Japanese.  In the updated version
there is a language selection dialog box when you start the game.  Please
note that on non-Japanese versions of Windows some Japanese characters may
not display correctly.

【アップデート内容】
・日本語対応
・日本語と英語の言語選択機能追加

notes.title: Dungeon Manager ZV Update!
notes.content:
http://ent.zoo.jp/images/DMZV_update_image01.png
Updated version of the game includes:
- In the Option screen, you can now select to not display popup messages
during game play.
- Some of the English text has been edited so it fits better where
displayed.

Thank you to the community for your requests and for pointing out some of
the problems.  We hope this makes for a better game experience.
